import pandas as pd

# Load data
cpg = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
chrom = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv', encoding='utf-8-sig')

print("CpG shape:", cpg.shape)
print("Number of unique Pos:", cpg['Pos'].nunique())
print("MT in chromosomes:", 'MT' in cpg['Chromosome'].astype(str).unique())

# For each unique CpG position, compute mean methylation across samples
unique_cpg = cpg.groupby(['Pos', 'Chromosome'], as_index=False).agg(
    MeanMeth=('MethylationPercentage', 'mean'),
    Count=('Sample', 'count')
)
print("\nUnique CpGs:", unique_cpg.shape)
print(unique_cpg.head())

# Filter for >90% or <10% methylation
filtered = unique_cpg[(unique_cpg['MeanMeth'] > 90) | (unique_cpg['MeanMeth'] < 10)]
print("\nFiltered CpGs (mean meth > 90 or < 10):", filtered.shape)

# Per chromosome counts
per_chrom_filtered = filtered.groupby('Chromosome').size().reset_index(name='FilteredCount')
print("\nPer chromosome filtered counts:")
print(per_chrom_filtered)

import pandas as pd

# Load data
cpg = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
chrom = pd.read_csv('/workspace/JD_Chromosome_Length.csv', encoding='utf-8-sig')

# Drop MT from chromosomes (file is noMT)
chrom['Chromosome'] = chrom['Chromosome'].astype(str)
chrom_noMT = chrom[chrom['Chromosome'] != 'MT'].copy()
print("Chromosomes (noMT):", chrom_noMT.shape)
print("Total genome length (noMT):", chrom_noMT['Length'].sum())

# Filter rows by methylation threshold and take unique CpGs
filtered_rows = cpg[(cpg['MethylationPercentage'] > 90) | (cpg['MethylationPercentage'] < 10)]
unique_filtered = filtered_rows.drop_duplicates(subset='Pos')[['Pos', 'Chromosome']]
unique_filtered['Chromosome'] = unique_filtered['Chromosome'].astype(str)
print("\nUnique filtered CpGs:", unique_filtered.shape[0])

# Per-chromosome counts
per_chrom = unique_filtered.groupby('Chromosome').size().reset_index(name='FilteredCount')
# Merge with chromosome lengths - all chromosomes including those with 0
merged = chrom_noMT.merge(per_chrom, on='Chromosome', how='left').fillna(0)
merged['FilteredCount'] = merged['FilteredCount'].astype(int)
merged['Density'] = merged['FilteredCount'] / merged['Length']
print("\nPer-chromosome density:")
print(merged.to_string())

# Method 1: total / total genome length
total_count = merged['FilteredCount'].sum()
total_length = merged['Length'].sum()
density_method1 = total_count / total_length
print(f"\nMethod 1 (total count / total length): {total_count}/{total_length} = {density_method1:.4e}")

# Method 2: average of per-chromosome densities (all chromosomes)
density_method2_all = merged['Density'].mean()
print(f"Method 2 (mean density across all chromosomes): {density_method2_all:.4e}")

# Method 3: average density only over chromosomes with at least one filtered CpG
density_method3 = merged[merged['FilteredCount'] > 0]['Density'].mean()
print(f"Method 3 (mean density across chromosomes with filtered CpGs): {density_method3:.4e}")
